services.title: Cooling Optimization
services.summary: We optimize industrial and commercial chiller plants through variable primary flow conversion, intelligent sequencing, condenser water reset, and cooling tower approach optimization, reducing chilling power consumption by 20% to 35%.
services.details: Cooling optimization addresses Delta-T syndrome, inefficient part-load chiller sequencing, and fouled heat transfer surfaces. We implement continuous adaptive control algorithms that dynamically adjust chilled water supply temperature and cooling tower setpoints according to ambient wet-bulb conditions.

services.title: Heating & Steam
services.summary: Full thermodynamic optimization of steam generation, distribution, and condensate recovery systems, achieving 15% to 30% fuel savings and recovering high-enthalpy condensate.
services.details: We audit boiler combustion efficiency, size and monitor thermodynamic/ball-float steam traps, recover heat from continuous blowdown streams, and engineer closed-loop pressurized condensate return systems to minimize flash steam loss and reduce boiler feedwater makeup demands.

services.title: Drying Processes
services.summary: Thermal optimization of industrial convective, rotary, and spray drying systems through psychrometric tuning, air recirculation, and exhaust energy recuperation.
services.details: Drying is one of the most energy-intensive industrial operations. Exergy Solutions models air humidity curves, installs heat pipe and plate heat exchangers on humid exhaust air streams to preheat incoming dry air, and tunes process burner modulation to prevent over-drying while ensuring product consistency.
benefits: Up to 25% energy savings on industrial dryers

services.title: Water Quality
services.summary: Comprehensive industrial water conservation, high-recovery reverse osmosis (RO) integration, cooling tower cycle optimization, and Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) engineering.
services.details: We minimize industrial freshwater intake by enhancing RO recovery rates up to 85-90%, upgrading cooling water chemical management to safely increase cycles of concentration (CoC), and recycling process rinse streams using membrane bioreactors (MBR) and advanced oxidation.
benefits: Minimized chemical consumption in cooling towers
Protection of heat exchangers from scaling and fouling

services.title: Waste-Heat Recovery
services.summary: Capturing unutilized industrial thermal energy from furnace exhaust, engine jackets, boiler flues, and wastewater to generate steam, hot water, or on-site electricity.
services.details: We implement condensing economizers, heat pipe exchangers, high-temperature heat pumps, and Organic Rankine Cycle (ORC) power generators that transform wasted low-to-medium grade thermal streams (80°C - 450°C) into direct utility offsets with typical paybacks under 2.5 years.
benefits: Substantial reduction in primary energy purchases
Direct generation of on-site electricity or high-grade heat

services.title: Process Integration
services.summary: System-wide Pinch Analysis and Heat Exchanger Network (HEN) synthesis to match hot and cold process streams, eliminating cross-pinch energy destruction.
services.details: Rather than evaluating utility equipment in isolation, Exergy Solutions performs rigorous thermodynamic pinch analysis across the entire facility. We construct Composite Curves and Grand Composite Curves to synthesize optimal heat exchanger networks, determining the thermodynamic limits of recovery before utility heaters or chillers are even applied.
benefits: Lower capital expenditure via optimized heat exchanger networks
Complete elimination of cross-pinch energy waste

faqs.question: What is Exergy and why does it matter over Energy?
faqs.answer: Energy is conserved according to the First Law of Thermodynamics, but exergy represents the useful work potential of that energy. Low-temperature heat cannot perform the same work as high-pressure steam. By conducting exergy analysis, Exergy Solutions pinpoints where true thermodynamic irreversibilities and inefficiencies occur, providing far superior economic and energy savings.

faqs.question: How do you start an engagement with a new client?
faqs.answer: We follow our proven 4-stage methodology: Diagnose, Model, Design, and Implement. It begins with an initial on-site or virtual walk-through diagnosis and baseline energy assessment to uncover quick wins and major capital recovery projects.

faqs.question: What is the typical return on investment (ROI)?
faqs.answer: Most of our operational and low-capex optimization projects have a payback period under 6 to 12 months. Capital heat recovery and process integration retrofits typically achieve a full ROI within 1.5 to 3 years.

faqs.question: Do you provide services in the UAE and Gulf region?
faqs.answer: Yes! Exergy Solutions is headquartered in Dubai, UAE, and operates extensively across the GCC region, helping industrial operators and commercial facilities align with UAE Net Zero 2050 and regional energy efficiency mandates.
